digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC test harness under tests/external/live_jira_dc/
propositions: Provide a Dockerized Jira 8.17.1 harness as a real Data Center verification oracle since DC licenses and an official OpenAPI spec are unavailable.

Vendor a Dockerfile that FROMs the addono base by digest, keeping -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout, because removing either causes silent cold-start or ~25-minute Cargo deploy-timeout failures.

The image does not contain Jira; atlas-run downloads ~900 artifacts from maven.atlassian.com at runtime, making egress a hard dependency and requiring a generous env-overridable readiness timeout and a persistent Maven cache.
The harness must run on a native amd64 runner because arm64 emulation prevents Jira from becoming usable within an hour; acceptance evidence must name the architecture it was produced on.

Place live tests in the external tier so they skip without REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 and a reachable instance, define _live_jira_ready for canary participation, and bind the port loopback-only to avoid exposing admin/admin credentials.
Teardown must assert delete HTTP status and poll each issue's direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoint until 404 per ADR 0037 §3, never consulting the lagging search index.
